action_tie_tolerance: choose first legal action with Q >= maximum legal Q - 1e-12

config_fields.packets: 1..4 public metadata records ordered by nondecreasing arrival

read.guard: clock < deadline AND budget_left > 0 AND clock >= recovery_until AND next packet exists AND arrival <= clock
read.packet: first unconsumed packet only, indexed by next_packet
read.observation: 0 or 1 from actual frozen FullHX logits; x for actual read/decode failure
read.cost: read_cost + (failure_cost if observation is x else 0)
read.failure: consumes packet, budget and tick; no posterior evidence update

stop.guard: all nonterminal states including initial state
stop.reward: external evaluator supplies int(answer == private truth)

illegal_action: do not access payload; actual STOP; cost invalid_cost + stop_cost
deadline: READ/WAIT may finish at deadline; next decision only STOP is legal
private_data: truth, votes, failures and payload bytes are absent from policy inputs
physical_clock: each READ/WAIT commits tick_micros through the real R9 native owner; STOP checkpoints task only and leaves native physics frontier unchanged
recovery: externally acknowledged composite digest binds task, policy, payload manifest, source and inner native frontier; incomplete intent or mismatched frontier fails closed
